purpose.domain_detail: JMA ORCA standard medical receipt (shinryo-hoshuu) software — monthly outpatient/inpatient billing summary report with CSV export capability
purpose.summary: This program (A00000D123) is part of the JMA ORCA open-source medical receipt system. It processes patient visit and insurance billing data to produce a monthly aggregate billing report (月次帳票/月計表), iterating over patient records from an indexed file and accumulating totals by department, physician, and insurance category. It also supports CSV file output of the summary data.

notable_features: 48 COPY statements referencing JMA ORCA-specific copybooks (.INC files)
77 CALL statements indicating heavy use of shared subroutines
ORGANIZATION INDEXED with DYNAMIC access mode
Japanese EUC/Shift-JIS encoded comments (latin-1 decoded with mojibake)
OCCURS tables for monthly/departmental summaries (SUM-MONTH-TBL OCCURS 26, SUM-YOSO-TBL OCCURS 48)
No COMP-3 usage despite financial calculations
Signed numeric fields using S9 PIC clauses
Version history embedded in comments spanning 2004–2014
verdict.notes: File is encoded in EUC-JP or Shift-JIS but decoded as latin-1, causing mojibake in Japanese comment text. Content is clearly identifiable as JMA ORCA production code. Source truncated at 16000 chars out of 168051 bytes (4047 lines total); full procedure division not visible but structural indicators (143 PERFORMs, 77 CALLs, 6 GOTOs) confirm substantial production logic.
